technology_name: NIR Photovoltaic Power Delivery for Implantable Devices
constitutional_basis: Article LII (falsification contract) + directive section 11 ('the decisive experiment must reproduce the relevant system conditions, including tissue-equivalent optical path and thermal considerations').
question: What is the cheapest credible way to learn whether this technology deserves more money?
hypothesis: A 940 nm transcutaneous source delivering through a tissue-equivalent optical path of representative thickness/composition produces, at an implanted GaAs PV receiver of the shipped geometry, electrical power within a pre-registered band around the recorded fluence (1.0-1.4 mW/cm²) and low-irradiance GaAs efficiency (~30 % class) — i.e. ~100-160 uW on the shipped 0.385 cm² receiver — while the path remains within the pre-registered thermal safety envelope.
null_hypothesis: Under the tissue-equivalent path, either (a) the PV-surface fluence falls materially below the 1.0-1.4 mW/cm² recorded range (the simulation chain's asserted value does not survive reality), (b) the low-irradiance PV efficiency is materially below the ~30 % class (the power chain collapses), or (c) sustained irradiation at the required source power violates the thermal envelope at the skin or implant surface (the concept is thermally infeasible at useful power).
control: A free-space (air-path) irradiation arm at identical source settings and identical PV receiver — isolates the tissue-path loss from every other loss (the same receiver, same electronics, same metering; only the optical path differs). Secondary control: a calibrated reference photodiode in the path plane to independently measure delivered fluence (instrument triangle: source meter, reference diode, PV electrical output).
treatment: Tissue-equivalent optical path (agar/silicone intralipid-class phantom at the Jacques-2013 940 nm mu_eff band 1.0-2.5 /cm, thickness representing the real implant depth — pre-registered per the target implantation site) ahead of the SAME GaAs PV receiver (shipped geometry class), with in-line thermal probes at the phantom entry surface and at the receiver.
apparatus: 940 nm source (laser/LED class, power-metered), motorized/positional fixture fixing source-phantom-receiver geometry, tissue-equivalent phantom slabs (mu_eff verified by a pre-registered cut-back measurement), calibrated reference photodiode, the GaAs PV receiver sample, IV-curve measurement (source-meter) for the PV, thermocouples/IR spot at entry + receiver, ambient control.
inputs: Source power sweep (from LOW to the pre-registered thermal-limit-derived maximum); phantom thickness set (the pre-registered implant-depth cases incl. a skull-analog case); PV receiver (shipped geometry); the free-space control arm.
outputs: Per condition: reference-diode fluence at the receiver plane; PV IV-curve -> electrical power and effective efficiency; PV-surface temperature and phantom-entry temperature; steady-state duration-holding results (thermal).
measurement_method: Calibrated photodiode fluence + source-meter IV curves + thermocouple temperatures; ≥3 repetitions per condition; phantom mu_eff verified by cut-back before the run; blinded analysis of the recorded traces.
baseline: The free-space control arm defines the no-tissue reference: the ratio (phantom-arm power / free-space-arm power) isolates the tissue-equivalent transmission; the reference photodiode cross-checks the simulation-asserted fluence range.
primary_endpoint: Electrical power from the receiver under the phantom path at the pre-registered source setting, compared against the pre-registered band derived from the recorded chain (fluence 1.0-1.4 mW/cm² × area 0.385 cm² × efficiency 0.30 → 116-162 uW). The band is DERIVED from recorded values (Constitution Art. XXVII MODEL_DERIVED class, shown derivation, not invented).
secondary_endpoints: Phantom-arm fluence vs the simulation-asserted 1.0-1.4 mW/cm² (does the asserted chain survive a physical path?)
Effective PV efficiency at ~1 mW/cm² (tests the ~30 % low-irradiance GaAs assumption — the module-vs-system conflation the directive forbids)
Tissue-equivalent transmission vs the Beer-Lambert EXTERNAL_PRECEDENT (60.7 %/28.7 % at 5 mm)
Steady-state surface/receiver temperatures vs the pre-registered thermal envelope (tissue-heating limit basis recorded as UNKNOWN — its derivation is PART of the pre-registration, owner-gated)
Encapsulation-on vs encapsulation-off transmission (closes ENERGY_BUDGET stage 4's UNKNOWN if a capped sample is included)
acceptance_threshold: ACCEPT only if the measured electrical power falls INSIDE the pre-registered band AND phantom fluence is consistent with the asserted range at the stated source setting AND temperatures remain within the pre-registered thermal envelope for a sustained-duration hold. Thresholds are pre-registered BEFORE the run with provenance (MODEL_DERIVED for the power band, EXTERNAL_PRECEDENT for optical properties, BUYER_DEFINED for thermal limits — classes never silently mixed, Constitution Art. XXVII).
falsifier: KILL the mechanism if: (a) phantom-path fluence is materially below the asserted range at any thermally-permissible source power (the recorded tissue chain does not survive reality — this kills the simulation-asserted basis of the whole package), or (b) low-irradiance efficiency collapses (no useful power density at safe fluence), or (c) the thermal envelope is violated at source powers needed for useful power (thermally infeasible). NOTE: a measured power BELOW the 500 uW device target but INSIDE the 116-162 uW recorded band does NOT kill the mechanism — it confirms the recorded chain and relocates the gap to a target/area decision (the D2 discrepancy), which is an engineering-tradeoff outcome, not a falsification.
uncertainty: Phantom is tissue-equivalent, not tissue (transfer risk to in-vivo: perfusion, heterogeneous scalp/skull); single-wavelength 940 nm (spectral selectivity of real tissue); thermal envelope basis currently unrecorded (owner-gated pre-registration); receiver sample is a representative GaAs cell, not the eventual implant-integrated device; biofouling/encapsulation aging effects are out of scope for the decisive test.
sample_size_basis: Minimum credible: 1 receiver × ≥3 phantom thickness cases × ≥3 source settings × ≥3 repetitions, plus the free-space control — sized to detect the order-of-magnitude question (does the recorded power chain survive a physical path), not to power a design-margin claim.
cost_basis: UNESTIMATED for this package — owner input required. Components are bench-class: NIR source, photodiode, source-meter, phantom materials, thermal probes; a comparable phantom + electrical characterization bench loop is materially cheaper than an animal study, which is exactly why it is the cheapest credible gate.
time_basis: UNESTIMATED — owner input required (component procurement and phantom calibration dominate; class: weeks-to-low-months, not a recorded estimate).
safety_constraints: No human/animal subjects; laser-safety class handling for the NIR source per lab protocol; phantom-only thermal testing (thermal limits pre-registered conservatively; no skin contact).
decision_rule: ACCEPT -> SPONSORED_VALIDATION with the first PHYSICAL_OBSERVATION-class evidence attached through the reality-boundary interface (Art. XXXVIII); the package then has a physically measured fluence/power/thermal triplet replacing the T2_ASSERTED state. KILL -> cemetery entry with the kill class (fluence-does-not-survive / efficiency-collapse / thermal-infeasibility) and the lesson codified. The D1/D2 arithmetic discrepancies must be resolved (inputs recorded or figure withdrawn) BEFORE the experiment's band can be defended — an owner action, not a silent edit.
prior_state: No decisive experiment contract existed at this schema level; the frozen dossier carries planned verification items (V-001..V-003 class, NOT_TESTED) and the MC pre-registration (R309) whose execution artifacts are absent. This contract is the versioned addition.
